Variants.Content: Draconys is located on the east bank of the Forest of Qohor and the River Rhoyne, and is politically within the woodland trade routes controlled or influenced by the city-state of Qohor. It is a town, a center where surrounding populations, markets, roads and local power converge. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.

Entry Dankonis Local families also relied on black goat sacrifices, trees, iron tools, furs, and trade routes through the forest; if any road, well, spring, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Dankonis They will also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the forests of Qohor; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, and true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hooves.

Entry Dankonis If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The craftsmen of Danconis rely on workshops, markets, roof tiles, church bells and the streets that have expanded through the ages to leave behind their craftsmanship, while the priests use black goats, guild secrets and ancient fears deep in the forest to explain life and death. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Dankonis They care about black goat sacrifices, forests, iron tools, furs, and trade routes through the forest. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see the coat of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
